name: 2D soft stylized with Among Us design
design:
A clean sci-fi environment in a soft cinematic 2D animation style, combining the original Among Us game design with gentle lighting and a slightly soft-rendered visual tone.

Scene:
[Describe the situation, environment, and action here. Keep it clear and story-driven.]

--------------------------------------------------

Character fidelity (CRITICAL):
- EXACT original Among Us crewmate design
- simple capsule-shaped body (rounded top, flat feet)
- NO arms, NO fingers, NO joints
- small backpack only
- no clothing details, no suit seams, no mechanical parts
- minimal design, smooth silhouette
- proportions identical to the original game
- visor is a simple glossy oval (light blue gradient with subtle highlight)
- no realism added to body structure
- no deformation (except zombie damage when specified)
- characters must look like authentic in-game Among Us assets

--------------------------------------------------

Composition:
- cinematic framing with clear subject focus
- camera angle adaptable to scene (over-the-shoulder, front, side, dynamic)
- strong depth using foreground / midground / background layering
- use doors, windows, corridors as natural framing elements
- composition must remain clean and readable (no clutter)

--------------------------------------------------

Characters:
- Among Us crewmates (yellow, red, etc.)
- no visible arms
- actions expressed through body tilt, direction, and spacing
- interaction must feel natural and readable without breaking silhouette rules

--------------------------------------------------

(OPTIONAL – when needed)
Zombie characters:
- Among Us crewmates mutated into zombies
- base silhouette MUST remain Among Us
- torn edges, damaged suits, broken shapes
- stylized open mouths with sharp teeth
- more aggressive shapes allowed, but still simple and graphic
- no realistic anatomy or muscles

--------------------------------------------------

Line style (VERY IMPORTANT):
- clean, smooth outlines
- slightly softer than rigid vector lines
- still consistent thickness (no wobble, no sketch)
- polished, animation-ready edges
- no roughness or broken lines

--------------------------------------------------

Color:
- slightly desaturated overall palette
- warm vs cool color contrast allowed
- soft gradients allowed ONLY for lighting transitions
- no harsh color separation
- no texture, no grain, no noise

--------------------------------------------------

Lighting (VERY IMPORTANT):
- soft cinematic lighting
- subtle glow and bloom effect (very controlled, not heavy)
- smooth shadow gradients (no hard shadows)
- lighting enhances mood, not realism

--------------------------------------------------

Environment design:
- simplified sci-fi structures (walls, doors, panels, consoles)
- clean geometric shapes
- minimal but intentional details
- environment must support the story/action clearly

--------------------------------------------------

Depth:
- clear separation of layers using scale and light
- soft atmospheric depth (slight fade in background)
- avoid harsh perspective distortion
- depth created by overlap + lighting, not heavy shading

--------------------------------------------------

Style:
- hybrid of flat 2D and soft cinematic rendering
- Among Us character design + soft Pixar-like lighting feel
- clean animation look with emotional tone
- slightly softened edges and lighting (NOT fully flat vector)

--------------------------------------------------

Surface quality:
- smooth, soft digital surfaces
- no hard textures
- no painterly strokes
- subtle softness in rendering

--------------------------------------------------

Mood:
- cinematic and immersive
- slightly emotional or atmospheric depending on scene
- soft, calm, or tense tone controlled by lighting

--------------------------------------------------

Avoid:
- realistic anatomy
- adding arms or joints
- complex suit details
- rough sketch lines
- noisy textures or grain
- overly sharp vector-only look
- harsh lighting or hard shadows
- over-detailed environments
- messy composition
